BOOTLEG BROADCAST — VERSION HISTORY

v0.33 — 7 October 2026
- Complete source catalogue reconciled from original monthly schedules, programme library, broadcast pools, collected link documents and current GitHub additions. Original X-Men, Spider-Man, Fox Kids and anime collections are searchable.
- Anime previously present in broadcast schedules restored to the timed pool. Series-balanced rotation prevents large episode collections from monopolising airtime. Beastars is exclusive to Japanime and capped at four episodes per UK day.
- Language evidence is visible and filterable. English audio-track tags are distinguished from uploader claims, unverified dubs and claimed English subtitles. Twelve anime files have compatible codecs and first audio-track English tags checked. Other languages/subtitles are not falsely marked verified.
- The viewer-reported Spanish New Scooby Doo Mysteries collection is held pending English replacements. Explicitly French/Spanish-labelled sources are also held.
- Collected leads are searchable without being automatically promoted as checked broadcast sources. Existing unverified sources retain their honest legacy status. New mixed-language anime files with untagged audio are not promoted based only on collection metadata.
- Source flags can be saved locally and exported. They hold TV playback after reloading the TV in the same browser; no backend or shared reporting service is required.
- Schedule Audit shows exact computed series airtime, repeated episode links and sources shared across channels, with JSON export.
- Original CRT art, VHS lettering, Halloween/winter decoration, remote and mobile layouts preserved. Mature anime classifications tightened, kids mornings preserved, spooky anime given October priority.
- Historical release notes consolidated here. Future additions should be appended to this file, rather than creating separate build-note documents.
- All-year timetable and static playback tests recorded in release-validation.json. Browser-rendered visual QA was unavailable; no fresh full spoken-audio/subtitle review of every collected file is claimed.



ARCHIVED NOTES — ORIGINAL TEXT

===== v0.32 GitHub export notes =====
BOOTLEG BROADCAST — GitHub Pages v0.32

This is the completed static v0.32 GitHub Pages export. Creating it has not updated either live site.

DEPLOY
1. Extract the ZIP. Copy its CONTENTS into your existing repository root, replacing matching files. index.html belongs at the repository root. Do not upload the ZIP itself as the website.
2. Commit and push using GitHub Desktop, or upload the extracted files with GitHub. Keep your existing GitHub Pages branch/root settings. Include .nojekyll where your file picker supports it.
3. Wait for GitHub Pages to finish deploying, then hard-refresh the site (Ctrl+F5 on Windows). No npm install, build step, server, API key or backend is required.

LOCAL REVIEW
Extract the ZIP and serve its folder with VS Code Live Server or another local static web server. Opening index.html as a file may block JSON loading.

THIS UPDATE
81 new catalogue entries, plus 23 checked alternate/replacement sources. Christmas is expanded across the channels, including British comedy and Nickelodeon specials. The source database shows annual holiday placement. Dedicated Valentine, St Patrick, Easter, Thanksgiving and New Year specials follow their actual dates. Existing Halloween additions, CRT room artwork, VHS lettering, remote and responsive layouts are included.

CALENDAR
Valentine's Day: 14 February. St Patrick's Day: 17 March. Western Easter Sunday is recalculated annually (5 April 2026; 28 March 2027). US Thanksgiving is the fourth Thursday of November (26 November 2026; 25 November 2027). New Year programmes run on 31 December and 1 January. Christmas rotates throughout December, with additional spotlights on 24–26 December. Christmas, winter and spring-themed material can retain wider seasonal windows. Date previews use the current UK year, and the timed engine recalculates movable dates without a yearly code update. The JSON month rotations are a 2026 snapshot; holiday eligibility comes from the annual rules, not the snapshot's weekday labels.

PLAYBACK WITHOUT A BACKEND
Scheduled positions use the viewer's device clock in Europe/London, including UK daylight saving. Viewers with accurate clocks join the same calculated programme; this is not server-clock synchronization. Channel controls, the full guide, searchable catalogue, selected-programme playback, retries and return to broadcast work on GitHub Pages. After hours is 02:30–07:00 UK; the December fireplace remains 03:00–04:00. Courage remains eligible 18:00–07:00 year-round with an October double bill starting at 18:00 daily.

Unavailable sources are held for the current TV visit, with retries/alternates and manual skip controls. On the timed broadcast, a failed slot retains its scheduled duration instead of shifting other viewers' clocks. Selected programmes can return to the current broadcast afterwards. Shared failure reports and central repair controls require a backend; the reports page explains this and hides its server controls. hosting-config.js keeps backend services off, so the static edition never calls absent /api routes.

SOURCE EVIDENCE
Holiday-source-review.md and holiday-review-v032.json list new sources, exact URLs, durations, codec checks, corrections and held candidates. Header/metadata checks do not constitute complete watch-throughs or language/subtitle verification. Unconfirmed codecs, edited clips, unclear compilations and subtitle/encoding issues are kept off the new broadcast additions. Previous source records remain included; this is not a fresh full-watch review of every legacy source. Halloween-source-review.md covers the preceding Halloween additions.

VALIDATION
3650 complete 2026 channel-day plans checked for contiguous boundaries, correct holiday eligibility, mature dayparts and airtime for every new catalogue entry. Future Easter dates, including the 2027 UK daylight-saving transition, are checked. Static playback controls, source filters, mobile layout calculations, all month files and local asset paths passed their checks. The separate clock check passes, including December Japanime mornings. Every October and December kids anime morning is covered. Two legacy Ben 10 originals with AC3 audio are held from TV playback and marked in the catalogue. Fresh rendered browser visual QA was unavailable; the existing room artwork/layout was preserved.

===== BUILD_NOTES_V0.25.txt =====
Bootleg Broadcast v0.25 — Full Additional Links + Source Fallback Pass

- Merged all current channel-specific Additional Links into their matching markdown libraries.
- Rebuilt the Additional Links schedule layer so every supplied channel-specific Additional Link appears somewhere in the 12-month broadcast schedule, rather than limiting each channel to two additions per day.
- Existing programme/ad/ident schedule content is preserved; v0.24 Additional-Link duplicates are removed before the v0.25 redistribution.
- Added source fallback support to app.js. Items may carry an `alternates` array. After two load failures the player tries the next alternate before skipping.
- Added manual alternate-source test: press A while a programme is selected/playing to cycle its attached alternate source.
- Trailer Park Boys legacy scheduled entries now use the newly supplied TPB sources first, with the previous source retained as an alternate, making TPB an immediate fallback test case.
- Movies, October and December remain dedicated non-channel pools and were not sprayed across unrelated channels. Their source files remain intact.

===== BUILD_NOTES_V0.26.txt =====
Bootleg Broadcast v0.26 — Viewer Experience & Reliability Pass

- Added CRT-style status messages for tuning, retries, backup sources, signal loss,
  volume, mute, power and standby.
- Corrected the Guide so adverts and idents are not mistaken for the programme
  currently playing. During a break it now identifies the break and marks the
  following programme as UP NEXT.
- Added persistent browser memory for the current channel, per-channel playback
  position, volume, mute state and remote drawer position.
- Replaced pause-based power detection with an explicit television power state.
- Added an on-screen HELP panel covering keyboard and touch controls.
- Added visible keyboard focus styling and improved dialog/status semantics.
- Made retry and alternate-source keys unique to the date, channel and playlist
  position so identically titled programmes cannot share failure state.
- Added visible messages for missing schedules and empty channels.
- Escaped schedule text before inserting it into the Guide.
- Optimised oversized 2000px channel logos for their small on-screen use.
- Re-encoded local 1080p channel idents to web-friendly 720p H.264 and retained
  fast-start metadata. The complete site was reduced from about 291 MB to 149 MB.

All programme schedules, advert pools, source URLs, alternate URLs, artwork and
the established CRT-room layout are otherwise preserved.


===== BUILD_NOTES_V0.27.1.txt =====
Bootleg Broadcast v0.27.1 — Guide Fit Adjustment

- Reduced the Guide width from 49% to 46% of the television container.
- Reduced its maximum height from 62% to 56%.
- Moved it slightly down and right inside the CRT glass.
- Tightened padding and marker width without returning to the previously tiny,
  illegible Guide text.
- Scheduling, Trailer Park Boys sources, fallback behaviour and all v0.27
  programme data are unchanged.


===== BUILD_NOTES_V0.27.txt =====
Bootleg Broadcast v0.27 — Curated Schedule & CRT Display Repair

DISPLAY
- Moved tuning, backup-source and no-signal messages into the centre of the CRT.
- Removed the modern bordered notification-card appearance.
- Recoloured messages as subdued phosphor/off-white television OSD text.
- Removed every rotation from the programme Guide.
- Enlarged the Guide, headings, programme titles and status markers for legibility.

TRAILER PARK BOYS
- Removed the dead legacy Trailer Park Boys source from active scheduling.
- Removed every incorrectly paired v0.25 fallback, including S8-S12 entries that
  did not have a supplied matching replacement episode.
- Inspected the Archive item metadata and excluded DVD menus, chapter fragments,
  combined-disc tracks and short extras.
- Built a verified 55-episode S1-S7 rotation from full-length episode files.
- Added five full-length specials/films.
- Added alternates only where the supplied files genuinely represent the same
  special, rather than matching unrelated season/episode numbers.
- Rebuilt all 614 existing TPB schedule slots with the verified rotation.
- Confirmed the two TPB episodes scheduled on September 19 return HTTP 200.

SCHEDULES
- Removed the 12,289-item v0.25 bulk insertion layer and its generated advert
  breaks from active schedules.
- Preserved the extracted links in programme-library.json rather than throwing
  the supplied collections away.
- Added a restrained, show-balanced rotation of one library programme per
  channel/day, allowing new collections into the Broadcast without overwhelming
  each existing daily schedule.
- Kept October and December free of the general rotation so their dedicated
  seasonal scheduling remains intact.
- Included tools/rebuild_schedules.py so the schedule policy is documented and
  repeatable.

PLAYBACK
- Failed programmes retry once and then try genuine attached alternates.
- If every source fails, the player now skips directly to another programme
  rather than treating the following advert break as successful playback.
- Three consecutive programme failures stop the loop and leave a visible
  NO SIGNAL / CHANGE CHANNEL message.
- Pressing A now shows whether a backup exists directly on the television.

All JSON files, local idents and JavaScript syntax are validated before release.


===== SCHEDULE_BUILD_NOTE.txt =====
BOOTLEG BROADCAST — VERSION 0.12 FULL-DAY / ADVERT PASS

Schedule changes:
- Ordinary days now rotate a manageable group of programmes rather than dumping every series into every day.
- Each selected series receives two consecutive episodes as a daily block.
- Daytime blocks remain before nighttime blocks.
- A single movie/special is used periodically rather than stacking several films together.
- Approved marathon channels retain one weekly single-season marathon day.
- October and December remain isolated seasonal schedules.
- Start/end channel idents remain in every channel day.

Advert system:
- Added adverts.json containing channel-specific advert pools.
- Schedule JSON files contain lightweight AdBreak placeholders.
- app.js expands each break at runtime with five randomly selected adverts.
- Recent advert history reduces immediate repeats during the same visit.
- Exact 2–5 minute duration cannot be guaranteed because the markdown contains URLs but no clip durations.

===== Holiday-programming.md =====
# Holiday programming

All times use Europe/London. No backend is required.

| Event | Placement |
| --- | --- |
| Valentine | 14 February |
| St Patrick | 17 March |
| Easter | Western Easter Sunday, recalculated each year |
| Thanksgiving | US Thanksgiving: fourth Thursday of November |
| New Year | 31 December and 1 January |
| Christmas | December rotation; spotlight on 24, 25 and 26 December |

The 2026 monthly files are rotation inputs; the timed planner evaluates the actual UK year. 2027 Easter is 28 March, and 2027 US Thanksgiving is 25 November. Date previews use the current UK year. Generic seasonal movies keep their wider theme windows; dedicated holiday episodes use annual date eligibility. Adult titles remain in their late-night windows. The source catalogue shows these rules under File and seasonal fit.

Calendar references: [UK holiday calendar](https://www.timeanddate.com/holidays/uk/easter-sunday) and [US federal holiday calendar](https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/pay-leave/federal-holidays/).


===== GITHUB-PAGES.md =====
# Deployment preference
GitHub Pages is the primary production target. Keep vanilla static client and relative asset/data paths compatible with /Bootleg-Broadcast/. Provide a ready-to-extract ZIP after updates. Do not publish updates without an explicit deployment request; the user is still tweaking. Backend services remain optional until a suitable backend is agreed. Keep device-clock fallback and per-visit failure skipping functional. Export must explain that server clock and central repair database are unavailable on Pages alone.

# Seasonal programming
Courage is eligible year-round from 18:00 to 07:00 Europe/London. October has a rotating Courage double bill at 18:00 daily plus increased Halloween rotation weight. Preserve UK daylight saving and morning age blocks. User uploads must have verified exact filenames, durations and playable browser media before entering live pools; retain unready files as held candidates.

# Holiday calendar
The static timed planner calculates holiday dates in the actual UK year: Valentine 14 February, St Patrick 17 March, Western Easter Sunday, US Thanksgiving on November's fourth Thursday, and New Year on 31 December/1 January. Christmas retains a whole-December rotation with 24–26 December spotlights. Use date eligibility for dedicated episodes and wider windows for generic seasonal films. Do not infer Easter from Eastern State/Easter Island or Christmas from the word Holiday alone. Keep unresolved codec/language/compilation sources held and document exact filenames, durations and codec evidence. Date previews use the current UK year; snapshots must not freeze future Easter/Thanksgiving dates.
